title: BEACON: Behavioral and Semantic Enrichment of AlphaEarth Embeddings through Tri-Modal Contrastive Learning
abstract: arXiv:2608.29553v1 Announce Type: new  Abstract: Geospatial foundation models such as the AlphaEarth Foundation produce compact and globally consistent representations of the Earth's surface that transfer effectively to a wide range of downstream tasks. However, because these models are trained primarily on Earth-observation imagery, their embeddings mainly capture physical and spectral characteristics while encoding human activity and urban function only weakly. To address this limitation, we propose BEACON, a tri-modal contrastive learning framework that aligns three complementary views of urban space: physical representations from AE embeddings, semantic representations from point-of-interest (POI) text, and human behavioral representations from hourly POI visitation, while keeping the deployed representation image-only. Using the Houston Metropolitan Area as a case study area, we evaluated the performance of the BEACON framework on nine downstream tasks, including seven regression

translated_title: BEACON：通过三模态对比学习对AlphaEarth嵌入进行行为与语义增强
translated_abstract: 诸如AlphaEarth Foundation之类的地理空间基础模型能够生成紧凑且全球一致的地球表面表示，并可有效迁移到广泛的下游任务。然而，由于这些模型主要基于地球观测影像进行训练，其嵌入主要捕捉物理和光谱特征，而对人类活动和城市功能的编码较为薄弱。为解决这一局限性，我们提出了BEACON，这是一个三模态对比学习框架，它对齐了城市空间的三个互补视图：来自AE嵌入的物理表示、来自兴趣点（POI）文本的语义表示，以及来自每小时POI访问量的人类行为表示，同时保持部署的表示仅依赖影像。以休斯顿都会区作为案例研究区域，我们在九个下游任务（包括七个回归任务……）上评估了BEACON框架的性能。
tldr: BEACON提出了一种三模态对比学习框架，通过融合AlphaEarth影像嵌入、POI文本语义和人类访问行为三种互补视图，增强地理空间基础模型对城市人类活动与功能的编码能力，同时保持部署时仅需影像输入。
en_tdlr: BEACON is a tri-modal contrastive learning framework that enriches AlphaEarth embeddings by aligning physical imagery, POI-text semantic, and human visitation behavioral views of urban space, improving the encoding of human activity and urban function while keeping the deployed representation image-only.
